description: This file defines classes and objects related to managing session events in Spark Connect, including session status, event posting, and event data structures for session start and close events.

classes.name: SessionStatus
classes.description: An abstract class representing the status of a session, with specific statuses Pending, Started, and Closed.

classes.name: SessionEventsManager
classes.description: Manages posting session start and close events, tracks session status, and ensures correct event sequencing.

classes.name: SparkListenerConnectSessionStarted
classes.description: Event data class for a session start event, including session ID, user ID, timestamp, and optional metadata.

classes.name: SparkListenerConnectSessionClosed
classes.description: Event data class for a session close event, including session ID, user ID, timestamp, and optional metadata.

methods.name: status_
methods.description: Sets the current session status internally.

methods.name: postStarted
methods.description: Posts a session started event to the listener bus after verifying the session is pending.

methods.name: postClosed
methods.description: Posts a session closed event to the listener bus after verifying the session was started.

methods.name: assertStatus
methods.description: Checks if the current session status is within valid statuses before posting an event.
